Lina (CS): Heads up — CardinalWell sent back the vendor questionnaire and singled out SOC2 scope + subprocessors. They want explicit language for the upcoming renewal.
Ben (Security): Can you paste the specific Qs?
Lina (CS): Sure, copied below:
```
Q4. Please list which services are in-scope for SOC2 (hosting, logging, backup, analytics).
Q9. Do you use any subprocessors for storage/backup? If so, list and provide DPA links.
Q14. After contract termination, what is the timeline and cert for permanent deletion?
Q21. How do you handle incident notifications for customer data breaches?
```
Asha (Legal): We'll want to avoid overly broad statements. We should confirm precisely which managed services are covered by our SOC2 attestation and which are operational (e.g., third-party CDN).
Marco (SRE): Quick run: hosting (Redwood Hosted API) and object storage (S3) are included in SOC2 scope. Logging pipeline is partially in-scope (ingestion and anonymized traces), analytics (telemetry/usage) is out-of-scope for customer content. Backups are encrypted snapshots stored in S3; snapshot process is included in infrastructure controls.
Ben (Security): Subprocessors: AWS (S3/EBS), Fastly (optional CDN), CloudQueueCorp (managed queueing for async jobs). We have DPAs with each; I'll pull the latest links.
Lina (CS): CardinalWell specifically asked whether backups/snapshots might be stored outside EU for their EU tenants.
Marco (SRE): By default we provision region-matched S3 buckets for tenant data. Occasional cross-region replication is disabled unless customer opts in. For EU tenants, snapshots remain in eu-central-1.
Asha (Legal): For the deletion question: our standard position is 60 days for primary deletion and 180 days for removable backups retention window; we can offer shorter windows on enterprise addendums. Need Ben to confirm the cert language.
Ben (Security): Confirmed: primary data purge job marks tenant for deletion and we purge live indices within 48 hours, snapshot retention policy expires at 60 days unless contract specifies otherwise. We can add a statement: "Upon termination, Redwood runs a complete deletion job and provides a deletion certificate within 30 days upon request."
Lina (CS): CardinalWell would like the deletion cert in writing as part of the DPA. Can Legal draft a short clause?
Asha (Legal): Will do. Drafting clause: "Redwood will provide a deletion certificate signed by an authorized officer within 30 days of the completion of data deletion procedures, documenting data locations and deletion actions." Thoughts?
Ben (Security): Works for me, keep it conditional on the customer providing a validated tenant identifier and contract termination confirmation.
Marco (SRE): Also note operational exceptions: forensic copies kept for active investigations are excluded until matter resolved; we document that in the playbook.
Lina (CS): Cardinal also wanted incident SLA: notify within 72 hours (standard), escalation to named contacts for high-severity.
Asha (Legal): We already accept 72-hour notification in our DPA template for security incidents that materially affect customer data. I'll attach DPA excerpt.
Marco (SRE): For the questionnaire response, can we include this mini runbook snippet?
```
Deletion runbook (summary):
- t0: customer termination received
- t+48h: live indices and API-access removed
- t+72h: deletion job queued and run
- t+30d: deletion certificate available upon request
- backups: retention 60d (default), 180d archival window for legal hold exceptions
```
Ben (Security): I'll assemble the SOC2 scope bullet list and public attestations link.
Infra Bot: Reminder: DPA and SOC2 attestations stored in #compliance-docs (internal) at 5106002500. Use template file `dpa-soc2-reply-template.md`.
Lina (CS): ETA for final response? Cardinal wants this by EOD tomorrow — it's blocking their procurement checklist for renewal.
Asha (Legal): I can have DPA clause + incident language by EOD today.
Ben (Security): I'll have SOC2 scope bullets and subprocessor links by noon.
Marco (SRE): I'll confirm region retention settings and the deletion cert workflow by 3pm.
Lina (CS): Perfect. I'll draft the vendor-form reply and send to CardinalWell once I have the pieces. Marking renewal-risk: high-priority until signed. :pushpin:
Ben (Security): Also recommend including a one-line about encryption: "All customer data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and in transit via TLS1.2+; key management options include Redwood-managed keys or BYOK with customer KEK."
Asha (Legal): Adding that to the DPA clause.
Lina (CS): Thanks team! I'll follow up in this thread if Cardinal sends additional items. :raised_hands:
